features.name: counterarg_comma_density
features.definition: What is the number of commas per word across all counter-argument comments pooled?
features.spec: Parse OC_comments with json.loads into a list of strings. If missing/malformed return null. Concatenate-count: commas = sum(c.count(',') for c in comments); words = sum(len(re.findall(r"\S+", c)) for c in comments). If the list is empty or words==0 return null; else commas/words (commas per word, pooled over all comments).

h0: counterarg_comma_density has no association with the probability that the OP changed their view (delta).
h1: Higher counterarg_comma_density is associated with a higher probability that the OP changed their view.
note: Persuasiveness is operationalized as the dataset outcome delta (OP view change). Comma density is a mechanical proxy for sentence complexity/information richness, which is not measured directly. Pooled commas per whitespace-delimited word across all comments; comments are not weighted equally. Comment text is raw and may include quotations, URLs, or delta-award/outcome announcements; no semantic filtering is applied. Comment order and timing are unknown. Association only, not causal.
